command:
set -eu
script_tmp=$(mktemp)
cat > "$script_tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_BACKUP_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
SOURCE_DIR=/srv/inventory/data
DEST_HOST=10.100.240.10
DEST_USER=inventory-backup
DEST_DIR=/var/backups/inventory
SSH_KEY=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_ed25519
KNOWN_HOSTS=/root/.ssh/inventory_backup_known_hosts
BACKUP_DATE=$(date +%F)
ARCHIVE="inventory-${BACKUP_DATE}.tar.gz"
LOCAL_TMP=$(mktemp /var/tmp/inventory-backup.XXXXXX.tar.gz)
REMOTE_TMP="${DEST_DIR}/.${ARCHIVE}.partial"

cleanup() {
    rm -f "$LOCAL_TMP"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

test -d "$SOURCE_DIR"
tar -C /srv/inventory -czf "$LOCAL_TMP" data
tar -tzf "$LOCAL_TMP" >/dev/null

scp -q -i "$SSH_KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" \
    "$LOCAL_TMP" "${DEST_USER}@${DEST_HOST}:${REMOTE_TMP}"

ssh -i "$SSH_KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile="$KNOWN_HOSTS" \
    "${DEST_USER}@${DEST_HOST}" \
    "set -eu; umask 077; test -s '${REMOTE_TMP}'; mv -f '${REMOTE_TMP}' '${DEST_DIR}/${ARCHIVE}'; find '${DEST_DIR}' -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -mtime +6 -delete"
ANTRIEB_BACKUP_SCRIPT
sudo install -o root -g root -m 0750 "$script_tmp" /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory
rm -f "$script_tmp"
cron_tmp=$(mktemp)
cat > "$cron_tmp" <<'ANTRIEB_CRON'
# Nightly node2 inventory backup to node1 at 02:15 local time.
15 2 * * * root /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory >>/var/log/inventory-backup.log 2>&1
ANTRIEB_CRON
sudo install -o root -g root -m 0644 "$cron_tmp" /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
rm -f "$cron_tmp"
sudo ls -l /usr/local/sbin/backup-inventory /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
sudo cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-backup
sudo systemctl is-active cron
